title: Live stream: a request that goes to a hub is answered when the hub answers; a refusal is an Error
description:
Epic mimid-e64f; docs/design/binary-live-stream.md §5.4, §9 question 3.

Chosen (Mark, 2026-11-20): a Send is answered once the hub answers, with one Ack carrying acceptedAt and frank, or one Error carrying the refusal; other traffic flows meanwhile.

Extended by the agent for mimid-e64f to every request that goes to a hub (INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC): Update, CreateRoom, ReportAbuse, FetchGroupInfo, FetchKeyMaterial. Ack means the operation was done; Error means it was not. A hub's refusal is an Error whose code is the refusal's name in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 (notAllowed, epochTooOld, wrongEpoch, invalidProposal, unverifiedMessage, refused), with the hub's fields (currentEpoch, invalidProposals, errorDescription, status). JMAP instead answers a hub refusal as a successful method response with responseCode. FetchGroupInfo is the exception: its Ack carries the whole GroupInfoResponse with its status, as JMAP does, because the client verifies the hub's signature over it.
close_reason: Decided by Mark 2026-11-20 (mimid-e64f); details marked INVENTED chosen by agent, unattended
